CHANGELOG — v1.1 — 2026-09-22

ADDED: Grand profile backups. Updated App and Helper identity cards.
LINGUA coverage-pack architecture. Literary/poetic user-facing
NamingRule. Locality recommendation and user-choice rules.
Translation-state/fallback rules. South African Family language
handling. Machine-readable GrandMasterRegister snapshot.

CHANGED: Localization architecture expanded beyond the older EN/SK +
public multilingual baseline. Official release language design now
separates universal, regional, locality and personal preference layers.
User-facing pack names are literary while internal identity remains
precise.

PRESERVED: Unresolved identities remain unresolved. Existing authority
boundaries are not redesigned. No source-code or physical verification
is claimed.
